sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 24932 of 2023
Applicant :- Sanjay Bind

Opposite Party :- State Of U.P.And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Roopesh Kumar Nigam,Awashesh Kumar,Kalp Dev Mishra,Udantika
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
No one appears for the informant despite notice.
2. The accused-applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No.03 of 2023 under sections 363, 366, 376 IPC and section 11(iv)/12 and 5/6 POCSO Act, Police Station Shadiabad, District Ghazipur.
3. The FIR in question was lodged alleging that the daughter of the informant was enticed.
Initially the FIR was registered as a missing person report.
Subsequently, in the statement under section 161 Cr.P.C., the victim stated that she had gone out of her own free will with the applicant and they had gone to Varanasi.
Subsequently, when they wanted to marry in a court, the police apprehended her.
The statement under section 164 is also to similar extent.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
It is argued by the counsel for the applicant that the age termination has been referred to CMO,
which report has not come so far, as such, there is no concrete material on record to determine the age of the victim which in any case has to be determined after process of leading evidence.
The applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 04.01.2023.

5. Considering the said documents on record, prima-facie the victim has not supported the prosecution version, the applicant has no criminal history and is languishing in jail since 04.01.2023, the applicant is entitled for the bail.
Thus the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Sanjay Bind be released on bail in aforesaid first information report number subject to his furnishing a personal bond and two reliable sureties of Rs.25000/- (Twenty Five Thousand) each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 18.12.2023 VNP/-
